notes.title: Save system update
notes.notes: We apologize for the inconvenience and bugs. The game now has a fixed save system. Enjoy the game! Old saves should work too!

notes.title: Update "Magic Stone"
notes.notes:
-- New: A magic stone has been added, which can very rarely appear in the dungeon. If it is destroyed, all the blocks along the x and y axes from this block will collapse. This will make your task much easier!
-- Updated main menu
-- Correction of the balance
-- Updated resource schedule
-- Character animation changes
-- Corrections of translations
-- The game has been transferred to a new version of the game engine
